lines.text: A great multitude in heaven shouts Hallelujah because God has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth.
The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures worship God, and a voice from the throne calls all who serve Him to praise.
A great multitude declares that the Lord reigns, and the Lamb's bride is given clothing of purple, bright and pure.
The angel tells John to write that those invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb are blessed.
John falls at the angel's feet to worship him, but the angel calls himself a fellow servant and says to worship Michael.
